question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
-- Now count users per age category
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN CAST((CAST('2016-10-01' AS DATE) - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST('2016-10-01' AS DATE) - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST('2016-10-01' AS DATE) - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST('2016-10-01' AS DATE) - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count
FROM mst_users 
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN CAST((CAST('2016-10-01' AS DATE) - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST('2016-10-01' AS DATE) - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST('2016-10-01' AS DATE) - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST('2016-10-01' AS DATE) - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END
ORDER BY 
  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3
    WHEN '50s' THEN 4
    WHEN 'others' THEN 5
  END
